analysis.description: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of experience replay in Q-learning methods, focusing on the replay capacity and the ratio of learning updates to experience collected (replay ratio). It highlights the importance of uncorrected n-step returns in improving performance across various algorithms.

type.justification: The paper is empirical as it involves systematic and extensive analysis of experience replay through experiments, primarily in reinforcement learning settings.
type.quote: We therefore present a systematic and extensive analysis of experience replay in Q-learning methods, focusing on two fundamental properties... Separately, by directly controlling the replay ratio we contextualize previous observations in the literature and empirically measure its importance across a variety of deep RL algorithms.

name.justification: The paper focuses on experience replay, a fundamental component of reinforcement learning algorithms, particularly in the context of Q-learning.
name.quote: Experience replay is central to off-policy algorithms in deep reinforcement learning (RL)...
